title: Yellow · headline + lifestyle photo + body
description: Nudge / re-engagement emails. Magenta [tokens] mark personalised merge fields.
usage: Relationship hero. Personal headline, warm lifestyle photo, short supporting copy. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: JPG, cover crop. 16px corner radius applied inline via CSS (square in Outlook).

notes: [Name] is a merge field shown in magenta (#FF00F5) — replace with the SFMC personalisation string before send.
Photo corners are rounded with inline border-radius:16px; Outlook desktop shows square corners (accepted per CONVENTIONS).
Mobile (≤480px): headline 38→28 (f28); side padding 48→32 (mobPad32); top padding 48→40 (padd-top) and bottom 48→30 (mob-pad-bot) vs Figma's 32; gaps 32→20 (himobtop) vs Figma's 24.
